== Course of events ==

After the Dodo's strange ceremony, in which all were declared winners and prizes distributed—Alice among them receiving a thimble—the girl found herself abandoned, left alone with her thoughts. In that solitude, loneliness descended upon her, and she was overcome with a tender longing to see her dear pet cat once more, that familiar creature who seemed so very far away in this bewildering realm. The Cheshire Cat watched with its inscrutable grin, but offered no true companionship to ease her melancholy.

Yet Alice's reverie would soon bear unexpected fruit. When she spoke aloud of her beloved cat Dinah by name, the effect was remarkable and startling: nearly all of the creatures assembled took flight in alarm, frightened by some quality inherent in the mention itself. Thus did her solitary yearning and the memory of her cherished companion set in motion a chain of consequences that would soon scatter the gathering and prompt the Dodo to devise yet another peculiar amusement.
